downstream_reviews.action: No dependency or API update is required: the current broker-only vqt_ths 0.9.3 does not depend on pytdxfeed. Its broker interface is unchanged.

Upgrade the exact pytdxfeed dependency and lock to 1.0.9 and update the compatibility marker. Each independently running Python consumer must call ensure_service to hold its own service lifetime. Verify shared callers and final-exit shutdown; raw HTTP payloads, OHLCV semantics and strategies are unchanged. Requires Python 3.13 or later, before Python 4.

fork_commits.summary: strict THS HTTP and JSONP response validation
strict post-close THS qfq daily-tail completion and TDX cross-check
historical THS qfq as-of boundary that isolates newer unstable tails
fail startup and health readiness when the code cache is unavailable
Bound raw TDX daily requests before network fetch while preserving previous-close fields
Reuse initialized market caches at startup, use the previous 09:00 refresh boundary before 09:00, and bound BSE HTTP requests to 10 seconds without fallback.
Limit workday refresh to index dates after the latest cached timestamp, avoiding repeated full-history requests while retaining existing cached dates and the same resulting workday set.

upstream_review.reason: Fetched upstream main and tags into a temporary bare repository on this audit run. HEAD remains ea07dccb67aeb92ebde851ac31503b4bf457a318, with zero commits and zero changed files from the recorded base and no tags. No upstream Go code, dependency, HTTP contract, market-data semantic or capability changes require adoption. Retain the six preceding fork fixes and add 1aac35309bf40b3219a005a39ee1ff8b46f4e8e3 so process-scoped startup reuses valid initialized caches instead of repeating full updates. The new fork changes cache initialization and an HTTP timeout, not market-data payload semantics. Retain the startup-cache fix and append f7902b27f30e73c8d791c102ad6c715be81015d4 to stop workday index requests at the latest cached timestamp; comparison with a complete cache and a copy missing the latest date confirmed the same final date set and unchanged older rows.

runtime_changes: Replace persistent LaunchAgent startup and crash restart with a subprocess shared by calling Python processes; stop after the last caller exits, including SIGTERM and SIGKILL.
Verify and remove the matching previous pytdxfeed LaunchAgent while preserving runtime assets, databases and logs; never stop an unknown external listener.
Drop inherited ownership in forked workers; a worker acquires its own lifetime by calling ensure_service. Reap exited helpers and permit subsequent explicit restart.
Keep existing strict health and market-data APIs; correct startup cache reuse in the pinned Go fork and bound BSE request time without data fallback.
Refresh only uncached workday dates in the Go service; report actual elapsed startup time and propagate child exit codes when initialization fails before the timeout.
Require Python >=3.13,<4, matching the current supported runtime and packaging configuration.
